triage.kind_span: This Schedule TO relates to the Fund’s offer to purchase for cash up to 25% or 4,470,149 shares of its outstanding common shares

subject_names.value: Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund
subject_names.span: This Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO is filed by Eaton Vance Short Duration Diversified Income Fund, a Massachusetts business trust

subject_tickers.span: The Shares are traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “EVG.”

security_class.span: Common Shares of Beneficial Interest, $.01 par value

price_basis.span: The Offer is for cash at a price per Share equal to 99% of the net asset value (“NAV”) of the Shares as of the close of ordinary trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires.

price_pct_nav.span: The Offer is for cash at a price per Share equal to 99% of the net asset value (“NAV”) of the Shares as of the close of ordinary trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires.

nav_pricing_date.value: close of ordinary trading on the NYSE on the date the Offer expires (or the date to which it is extended)
nav_pricing_date.span: The purchase price will equal 99% of the Fund’s net asset value (“NAV”) per Share as of the close of regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) on the date the Offer expires, July 30, 2021 (or if the Offer is extended, on the date to which the Offer is extended)

size_pct_outstanding.span: has authorized the Fund to conduct a cash tender offer to purchase up to 25% or 4,470,149 (the “Offer Amount”)

size_shares.span: has authorized the Fund to conduct a cash tender offer to purchase up to 25% or 4,470,149 (the “Offer Amount”)

expiration_date.span: The Offer expires on July 30, 2021 at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, unless the Fund extends the Offer.

proration.span: If more than 25% of the Fund’s Shares are tendered and not withdrawn, any purchases will be made on a pro rata basis (disregarding fractional shares).

trigger_origin.span: In connection with the Transaction, Fund shareholders were asked to approve a new investment advisory agreement with EVM (the “New Agreement”) in order to maintain the continuity of the Fund’s operations. As announced on March 9, 2021, the Board approved the Offer, conditioned on Fund shareholders approving the New Agreement.

notes: Commencement document (Schedule TO-I plus Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal); no results fields. commencement_date is the date of the Offer to Purchase (June 29, 2021); the excerpt does not say in so many words that the offer opens that day (withdrawal rights refer to August 25, 2021 as 40 business days from commencement). trigger_origin: the Board approved the tender in connection with Morgan Stanley's acquisition of Eaton Vance Corp. (the adviser's parent, the 'Transaction'), conditioned on shareholders approving the new advisory agreement; that condition was already met on May 7, 2021, so shareholder_approval is not listed among the open conditions. conditions are from Section 13: the asset-coverage condition is coded 'other'; banking moratorium and credit-limitation conditions were folded into market_disruption; the fiduciary-duty condition into board_discretion. The Offer states it is not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. The filing is internally inconsistent on NAV: the Summary Term Sheet gives the June 23, 2021 NAV as $13.6727 per Share (and closing price $13.24), while the Introduction and Section 1 say the NAV was $13.24 per Share; the fee table uses $13.5360 = 99% of $13.6727. Shares outstanding as of June 23, 2021: 17,880,596. The excerpt ends mid-way through the Letter of Transmittal instructions; later exhibits (e.g. press release) are not in the excerpt.
